title: Cosmic apples
summary: Cosmic apples now turn up in carriage chests. Eat one for perk points to spend this life: a Cosmic Apple gives 1, a Celestial Bite gives 5 and a Violet Core gives 10. The rarer apples only appear further along the train.
highlights: Three apples, each worth more perk points than the last
The deeper you ride, the better the apples you can find
